whatIs.title: What is CS Interview Prep?
whatIs.description: A tool to prepare for technical interviews at IT companies. It provides 100 frequently asked questions with model answers across 10 CS fields including Data Structures, Algorithms, Network, OS, and Database. Practice mode lets you rehearse answers and self-evaluate to identify weak areas.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: In practice mode, read the question and try answering it yourself first
Click 'Show Answer' to see the model answer and key points
Rate yourself: 'Got It' if confident, 'Review Again' if not
Use the 'Needs Review' filter to focus on weak questions
Click related terms to study concepts in the CS Dictionary

tips.title: Interview Tips
items: Lead with your conclusion, then add reasoning and examples
Naturally include key technical terms to demonstrate expertise
Adding real project experience gives depth to your answers
Preparing for follow-up questions shows strong fundamentals

items.q: Do junior developers need to know all this?
items.a: Beginner level is essential for juniors, intermediate for 1-3 years experience, and advanced for seniors. Start with difficulty matching your career level.

items.q: Should I memorize the answers word for word?
items.a: No. Understand the key points and practice explaining in your own words. Understanding beats memorization in interviews.

items.q: Which category should I start with?
items.a: Start with Data Structures and Algorithms, then Network and OS. Add DB, Security, or Web based on the position you're applying for.
